rules.label: Income-based assistance: 0-250% FPL
rules.quote: Patients approved for Financial Assistance with an annual Family Income of 250% of FPL guidelines or less will receive a 100% discount on gross charges for care covered by this policy

rules.label: Income-based assistance: 251-400% FPL
rules.quote: Patients approved for Financial Assistance with an annual Family Income between 251% and 400% of FPL guidelines will receive a discount on gross charges as outlined in Appendix A

rules.label: Catastrophic Balance Financial Assistance
rules.quote: The Patient's outstanding single account balance due after all insurance or third-party payments and/or discounts (including the application of Financial Assistance based on family income alone) is greater than 50% of the Patient's total annual Family Income and Financial Resources combined

rules.label: Presumptive Eligibility
rules.quote: Patients granted Presumptive Eligibility for Financial Assistance will receive a 100% discount on gross charges for care covered by this policy

rules.label: Self-pay / uninsured discount at billing
rules.quote: Self-pay Guarantors automatically receive a discount on total billed charges at time of billing

application.quote: 365 days from the date of the first post-discharge Billing Statement
30 days after notice of the initiation of one or more Extraordinary Collection Actions (ECA) has been provided

eca_not_before.quote: UCHealth will refrain from initiating ECAs for at least 365 days from the date the Hospital mails the first post-discharge Billing Statement

notes: Residency requirement (Colorado resident) applies to Financial Assistance but may be waived at hospital's sole discretion for unscheduled emergency services (B.2). UCHealth employees residing outside Colorado are exempt from residency requirement (A.9).

Services not covered: non-emergent/non-medically-necessary care (elective/cosmetic), transplant procedures, self-pay packages, single case agreements, grants & research, or when third party has legal obligation to pay (C.2).

Discounts for 251-400% FPL and Catastrophic assistance are facility-specific per Appendix A tables (AGB percentages). AGB discount applies; if self-pay discount > AGB, self-pay discount used instead (H.5, H.6).
Patients approved for Financial Assistance will not be charged more than Amount Generally Billed (AGB) for insured patients (H.5).
Presumptive eligibility only applies to current services and past accounts, not future services (G.4).
Application processing within 14 days of receipt (F.5). Income-based eligibility valid 365 days (≤250% FPL) or 180 days (251-400% FPL) from last signed application (F.6, F.7).
Incomplete applications denied but no ECAs initiated; 30-day notice with missing info provided; applicant can complete within application period or 30 days of notice (F.8).
ECAs reversed and refunds issued for overpayments >$1 upon approval (F.9).
No credit reporting or property liens for patient debt (I.7).
Four monthly billing statements sent before collections referral; insured accounts referred after 120 days unpaid, uninsured after 182 days (I.5).
Family definition: 2+ people related by birth/marriage/adoption residing together; members not responsible for patients 18+ (Definitions).
Financial Resources: cash, bank deposits, easily withdrawable assets (checking, savings, trusts, CDs) (Definitions).

Income includes wages, unemployment, workers comp, SSI, public assistance, veterans payments, survivor benefits, pension, interest, dividends, rents, royalties, estates, trusts, educational assistance, alimony, child support, outside assistance; excludes non-cash benefits (Definitions).
Provider coverage list maintained separately and updated quarterly (C.1).

eca_not_before.quote: UCHealth does not initiate ECAs prior to (a) 365 days from the date UCHealth provides the first post-discharge Billing Statement to the Patient; and (b) reasonable efforts have been made to determine whether a Guarantor is approved for Financial Assistance under this policy, as described in this section.

notes: Residency exception: For unscheduled emergency services, UCHealth may, at its sole discretion, make an exception to the residency requirement.

Self-pay discount reversal: When a Patient's application for Financial Assistance is approved, the self-pay discount will be reversed and the Patients will receive a discount on gross charges as outlined in the above Section titled Discounts and Appendix A of this policy.

AGB cap: UCHealth will not charge Patients approved for Financial Assistance more than the amount generally billed (AGB) by UCHealth to insured Patients for emergency or Medically Necessary care covered by this policy.

Catastrophic discount detail: Patients approved for Catastrophic Balance Financial Assistance will receive a discount on gross charges as outlined in Appendix A or 50% of their total annual Family Income, whichever results in the lesser outstanding balance due.

Presumptive eligibility FPL limit: Information from the predictive model may be used to determine presumptive eligibility for Financial Assistance when the estimated household FPL is reported to be 250% or less.
Presumptive eligibility scope: Presumptive eligibility for Financial Assistance will only apply to current services and past accounts. Presumptive eligibility does not extend to future services.

Validity periods: If Family Income is at or below 250% of FPL, Financial Assistance is valid for 365 days from the date of the last signed and dated Financial Assistance Application. If Family Income is between 251-400% of FPL, eligibility for Financial Assistance is valid for 180 days from the date of the last signed and dated Financial Assistance Application.

Non-covered services: Health care services that are not emergent or Medically Necessary, including elective or cosmetic surgery; and Health care services related to a transplant procedure, self-pay package, single case agreement, grants & research, or when there is a legal obligation for a third party to pay a claim.

UCHealth employees exemption: UCHealth employees residing outside the State of Colorado, but who receive services at a UCHealth facility do not have to meet residency requirements for financial assistance applications they may request.

No denial for lack of public benefits: UCHealth does not deny discounted care on the basis the patient has not applied for any public benefits program or deny an admission or treatment because the patient may qualify for discounted care.
Service area note: Services provided at UCHealth clinics both inside and outside of Colorado are eligible for UCHealth Financial Assistance.

disagreements_before: A household of 3 earning $27,000 a year (98.8% of the poverty line), living in Colorado, uninsured, owing $10,000: the Nemotron 3 Ultra model gives 100% off, the Nemotron 3 Super model gives no help.

One person earning $68,000 a year (426.1% of the poverty line), living in Colorado, uninsured, owing $10,000: the Nemotron 3 Ultra model gives help (amount not stated), the Nemotron 3 Super model gives no help.

A household of 3 earning $20,000 a year (73.2% of the poverty line), living in Colorado, insured, and not under-insured as the policy defines it, owing $10,000, enrolled in SNAP, WIC or a similar program (or homeless): the Nemotron 3 Ultra model gives 100% off, the Nemotron 3 Super model gives no help.
